Born--Hopf Geometry — Source-matched geometry bridge impact audit (bounded)

Audit record: Paper00-GeometryBridgeSourceImpactAudit-v1_1
Source release: Paper00-PapersMinimal-v3_068.zip (SHA-256 fe55e4544d4f72c92df94edfbfd0a3da2baeb4b80c60c3f08bb69e8167f39adb)
Parent audit archive: Paper00-ProofChainAudits-v1_82(1).zip
Protocol: ProofChainAuditProtocol v1.1 and RigorousVerificationDAGWorkProtocol v2.4.
Review scope: E0/E1/E2 checks of the adopted source additions, not multi-agent/global E3/E4 proof audit.

What was checked

  • Source versions: seven edited TeX/PDF pairs, other 24 pairs byte-identical to the supplied v3.067 release.
  • Source graph: 31 uniquely current manuscripts; 24 new unique labels; zero duplicates; every \ref in the seven appended source-integrations points to a label in the current 31-source registry.
  • Builds: seven TeX/PDF pairs compiled; the final logs show no unresolved citations or references after regenerating the current-source AUX alias bank; no LaTeX control-sequence errors.
  • Exact scripts replayed: research Batches 3, 4, 5, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 (original verification files v1_4,v1_5,v1_6,v1_9,v1_11,v1_12,v1_13,v1_14,v1_15); all returned zero. The optional full 600-coordinate fixture replay in the B4/B5 lightweight scripts remained NOT_RUN in this round. Earlier complete 600-dimensional checks are inherited research evidence and are not reclassified as a new independent audit.
  • Proof scope: the 600-cell/Petersen Green-function data already proved in I-B are preserved and not counted as newly closed. The scalar first-shell and 70-dimensional local composite are scoped source results, not observed particles. Paper II-C's unrestricted seven-outcome theorem is retained, while the new eight-outcome result is support-restricted.

Current physical frontier and no-promotion gate

The new finite sources do not satisfy the existing V-C physical decay certificate just by possessing nonzero Grams. The missing material route requires actual generation of the Petersen-to-weak source derivative by the complete action, kinetically normalized and occupied weak-boson mode, full local Gauss-reduced Fock/interacting state, physical parent/daughter pole projections with energy support, proper-time response, complete daughter multiset and individual partial widths. The 600-chamber comparison Hamiltonian is not the QCD/Fock action. The third-color invariant chart line is not an SU(3) singlet, and local 70 source multiplicity is not baryon multiplicity.

Independence / adversarial status

The selected exact scripts independently confirm algebraic identities on the specific cited carriers. This audit has not conducted a fresh multi-party adversarial search against all new proofs, has not established the full 600-to-interacting-Fock action map and has not recomputed global condition/descendant reach. The historical canonical DAG proof statuses and source occurrence/physical width obligations stay unchanged. This bounded audit is attached as an E0/E1/E2 evidence layer with explicit status guards.
